videos.title: Introduction to Materials
videos.description:
All the materials in your kit are explained, and you will learn to prep the canvas for painting. Applying a CLEAR COAT is a very important step; DO NOT skip. The canvas should be FLAT before you start, so make sure you have weighted it on a flat surface for TWO (2) days.
